studio_binding_proposal.canonical_blob_tier: Proposed shared Studio/CKC/Tailor binding: existing ArtifactStore, UUID-addressed with content hashes and per-artifact manifests. CKC media already uses it. Loom still has a separate live blob path; consolidation is unimplemented mission work. Retention covers eligible L3 TTL artifacts only.
studio_binding_proposal.why: Reuse ArtifactStore integrity checks, manifests and CKC catalog references. Media ingress streams with a size cap; reads verify the complete payload before returning buffered bytes. Loom provides a separate Range-capable path. Convergence must preserve existing asset references and seeking; migration and verified Range delivery are not implemented. The concrete PRIM-ArtifactManifest mapping requires the canonical spec amendment.

read_path_contract.catalog_identity: Proposed concrete mapping: PRIM-Asset = atelier_media_asset.asset_id (UUID v7).
read_path_contract.manifest_identity: Proposed PRIM-ArtifactManifest handle: artifact://.handshake/artifacts/<layer>/<uuid>/artifact.json, or a formally specified equivalent. This does not establish implemented Studio placed-asset persistence.
read_path_contract.resolve_bytes: GET /atelier/media-assets/{asset_id}/bytes calls AtelierStore::read_media_asset_bytes and returns verified buffered bytes with catalog MIME, Content-Length, ETag, Cache-Control, x-hsk-artifact-ref and x-hsk-content-sha256. Unknown catalog identity and missing payload both return 404; invalid native references return 400; integrity failures return 500. GET does not extract an actor header or establish ResourceBroker authorization or per-read attribution. Studio link-state resolution remains unimplemented: distinguish absent catalog identity from missing bytes and preserve unauthorized as distinct from missing under STU-ASSET-007/021.
read_path_contract.streaming: Implemented: size-capped streaming ingress; complete-payload verification followed by buffered reads without Range. Loom supports Range without equivalent payload verification. Convergence must define and prove integrity-preserving seeking; verification caches and chunk maps are unselected design candidates.

studio_binding_proposal.crash_consistency_rule: Blob write and verification precede the catalog commit. The writer attempts to remove its newly written blob on catalog failure or deduplication; cleanup errors are logged and can leave orphans. Domain row and EventLedger event must commit in one SurrealDB transaction using the existing transaction pattern. A hard crash between payload publication and catalog commit can leave L1 orphans; retention scans only eligible L3 TTL artifacts. Filesystem health reports healthy, manifest-readable artifacts lacking tracked references as UntrackedOriginal, skips malformed/incomplete entries, and never reclaims them. A catalog row with missing bytes produces a byte-route 404 and requires explicit diagnosis rather than silent repair. An uncataloged orphan cannot resolve through the media byte route; re-ingestion may create a new catalog-backed artifact and does not discover or reclaim the orphan.
studio_binding_proposal.size_limits_and_eviction: Streaming ingest enforces HANDSHAKE_MEDIA_INGEST_MAX_BYTES, default 4 GiB. Loom JSON/base64 import has the Axum 2 MiB body default plus the decoded cap and is not a bulk path. Current CKC streaming ingestion writes L1 artifacts without TTL; plan_ttl_artifact_gc only evicts unpinned, expired L3 artifacts with retention_ttl_days and therefore does not evict these originals. Studio placement is proposed. Derived Studio previews/proxies may use L3 with TTL, eligible for that retention policy; originals remain L1 without TTL. Any future L1 reclamation must account for catalog and live placed-link references.
studio_binding_proposal.viewport: Proposed: expose a CKC-backed projection inside Studio per STU-ASSET-017, reusing AtelierPanel and typed AtelierRef drag payloads. Show character albums, media, tags/notes/ratings, Posekit, intake and search. Merely opening a separate CKC module does not satisfy the in-Studio requirement. Current AtelierEditor mounts CanvasBoard; Studio asset.place, placed-asset persistence and the projection are not implemented by the panel code. Preserve the inspected 128 atelier-ckc-* widget IDs; Argus must exercise the mounted runtime after gated MT-065 integration. Tailor and cui-studio use the same binding under STU-ASSET-020.
spec_should_say: Proposed STU-ASSET-025 amendment, not closure: record ArtifactStore API, UUID addressing, hash verification, configured ingest cap, eligible L3 TTL retention and blob-before-row compensation/transaction relationship. Canonical v02.206 still declares the gap; this proposal neither amends it nor passes STU-ASSET-030 activation.
Preserve STU-ASSET-004. Consolidating the live Loom blob path remains uncompleted mission work; this proposal does not defer it to a separate migration WP.

Proposed STU-ASSET-005 mapping: manifest reference and normalized SHA256. Preserve every canonical link field, Studio-owned transform/crop/fit/frame state and linked/embedded provenance; the byte route does not implement those records.

Preserve STU-ASSET-007/021 unchanged. Media GET has no handler-level actor extraction or ResourceBroker decision; POST attribution does not attribute GET. Authorization, denial receipts and unauthorized remain required and unimplemented.
STU-ASSET-008: bulk binary MUST ingest through the streaming route with the ceiling; base64/JSON ingest is forbidden for Studio assets.

STU-ASSET-012..014 export-back is not complete: require StudioDocument id/revision, StudioExportRecipe id/resolved parameters, manifest id, consumed source asset ids, KernelActor and EventLedger event id, plus catalog derivation edges from each source to export. Streaming ingestion alone does not supply this contract.

STU-ASSET-004 forbids a new parallel Studio library/blob tier. Loom import/content still use separate storage with row-before-file writes and Range. Consolidation remains uncompleted mission work; directing new callers to streaming ingestion is not migration proof.

STU-ASSET-008/009: a SECOND verified byte route exists and adds Posekit-specific manifest and sidecar checks. GET /atelier/posekit/openpose-png/bytes?artifact_ref= resolves the manifest, requires a Posekit-generated L1 image/png, requires a rendered atelier_pose_sidecar row bound to the same ref, and requires that row to agree with the manifest on hash (via the canonical sha256_refs_match), size and MIME before reading; it then goes through the same read_file_artifact_with_manifest, so the payload is re-hashed exactly as on the media route. Sidecar missing = 404, sidecar-vs-manifest drift = 500. The existing backend route is reusable for Studio Posekit consumption; Studio integration and export/publish guarantees remain unimplemented.
declared_debt: Loom consolidation remains unimplemented; preserve identities, references, byte integrity, recovery and Range.
Interrupted L1 ingest can leave orphans; L3 TTL retention and report-only filesystem health do not reclaim them. Recovery must preserve live catalog/document references.
Studio viewport, placed links, five link states and typed commands remain future consumer implementation.
Export-back needs full STU-ASSET-013 provenance and STU-ASSET-014 catalog derivation edges.
Cross-module authorization, per-read attribution and denial receipts are not implemented by media GET.
STU-ASSET-025 remains declared pending governed amendment and proof; preserve STU-ASSET-020 shared Studio/Tailor/cui-studio binding.

artifact_store.manifest: Existing ArtifactManifest carries MIME, size, hash, classification and retention fields; proposed PRIM-ArtifactManifest mapping does not prove Studio export provenance.
artifact_store.write: atomic temp -> fsync -> rename; refuses content_hash != sha256(payload); write-once
artifact_store.read_verification: yes - read_file_artifact re-hashes the payload against the manifest before serving

loom_blobs.write: write_file_atomic after the row is created (row -> blob, no compensation)
loom_blobs.read_verification: none - api/loom.rs get_asset_content resolves the path from the row content_hash and streams the file without re-hashing
loom_blobs.range_requests: YES (GAP-LM-009b, honors HTTP Range for long-video seeking)
